create_MeanVarBanditEnv: create a MeanVarBanditEnv instance with an optional seed for reproducible bandit environment testing
run_MeanVarBanditEnv_step: run a step in the MeanVarBanditEnv by passing action 0 or 1 to get reward and observation
reset_MeanVarBanditEnv: reset the MeanVarBanditEnv to its initial state and get the starting observation
test_MeanVarBanditEnv_variance: test if safe RL algorithms prefer lower variance returns using the MeanVarBanditEnv
get_MeanVarBanditEnv_observation: get the current observation from the MeanVarBanditEnv as a numpy array with one-hot encoding
